meta.experiment: E-32r.3.1 (tail-J consistency recompute of E-32r.3; adds s_l_tail, d3_by_r_tail, a_vs_ESG_cos_tail, id_cos_JR_Jtail, cross_checks_tail; everything else byte-identical to E-32r.3)
meta.fit: dz = a*e + b*e^2 + c*e^3 (no const), eps absolute in h
meta.s_l_tail: same as s_l with the denominator from J_tail = analytic_J(W_U, g, h) (decoder-tail Jacobian)
meta.slope_ratio: E-32r.2 formula UNCHANGED: median of |dz(e0)|/e0 / (|dz(e1)|/e1); 1.0 = linear regime
meta.quad_frac: NEW (no E-32r.2 counterpart): (s1-s2)/|s2|, s1=||a1||, s2=||a1+2*(eps0*||h_t||)*a2||; 0 = quadratic term negligible at eps0
meta.a_vs_ESG_cos: FIT-QUALITY sanity check (chain rule a1 = J e, exact for any J): ~1 expected on every layer with small resid_frac; NOT a depth metric
meta.a_vs_ESG_cos_tail: (A) semantics (reviewer 2026-10-17): injection direction = JR (full-chain), forward = tail -> measures the JR-vs-Jtail row misalignment, NOT fit quality; ~1 at L23 (E-35 identity), rising with depth
meta.id_cos_JR_Jtail: Frobenius cos(JR, J_tail) per position, median over docs — the desync guard
meta.aggregation: E-34: per-doc median -> median/IQR over docs
meta.sentinel: P128_RAW.sum < 0.5, endpoints-only valid pairs; sentinel_frac = share raw rows, nb_median over ~sent
meta.p0: canonical t0 position, NORMALIZED to sum 1
meta.d3: top-r right singular direction angle (cos-sim, exp33r)
meta.d3_fixP_note: diagnostics only on mid layers (TЗ §9: J = M_K*P_u exact only at L23)
